DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の掲示板についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about the community noticeboard, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。近所の人と小さな日本語交流会を開きます。案内を貼れる場所があるか聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交流会案内の掲示場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am organizing a small Japanese language exchange with people in the neighborhood. I came to ask whether there is somewhere we can put up a notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where you can post a notice about the exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず案内の内容を拝見してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I look at the contents of your notice first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。参加費は無料ですが、会場が狭いので、事前に電話で申し込んでもらう予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無料開催と事前電話申込を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. Participation is free, but the venue is small, so we plan to have people register by telephone in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the event is free and advance registration by telephone is required. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この掲示板では、担当者が内容を確認してから掲示します。連絡先はこの番号でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Notices go on this board after the person in charge checks their contents. Is this the correct contact number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その番号は私の携帯です。仕事中は出られないので、受付時間を夕方六時から八時までと書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話受付時間を書き足すと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is my mobile number. I cannot answer while working, so I will add that calls are accepted from six to eight in the evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to add the hours for telephone registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 開催日が過ぎた案内を取り下げるため、掲示の終了日も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also need an end date for displaying the notice so we can take it down after the event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 交流会の翌日に外してください。日付だけでは分かりにくいので、曜日も一緒に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 翌日の撤去と曜日表記を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please take it down the day after the exchange. A date alone may be unclear, so I will include the day of the week too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request removal the following day and say you will include the day of the week. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 修正した案内を提出いただければ、担当者から確認結果をご連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you submit the revised notice, the person in charge will contact you with the result of the check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は申請だけですね。貼ってよいと連絡が来てから、必要な枚数を印刷します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 許可の連絡後に印刷すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: So today I am only applying. I will print the number of copies we need after I receive confirmation that we may post it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will print after receiving permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その流れでお願いいたします。案内がまとまりましたら、またお越しください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please follow that procedure. Please come back when your notice is ready. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察後のお忘れ物についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about something left behind after your appointment, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帰宅してから上着がないことに気付きました。診察室で脱いだので、残っていないか確認をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察室で脱いだ上着の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: After I got home, I realized my jacket was missing. I took it off in the examination room. Could you check whether it is still there?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to check for the jacket you took off in the examination room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受診された時間と、上着の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me when you were seen and what the jacket looks like.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午前中の最後の診察です。灰色の上着で、内側に赤い名前のテープを縫い付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受診時間と名前テープ付き上着を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had the last appointment of the morning. It is a gray jacket with red name tape sewn on the inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe your appointment time and the jacket with name tape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その特徴の上着が届いています。内側の名前を確認してからお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: A jacket matching that description has been handed in. We will check the name inside before returning it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の名字が書いてあります。上着を受け取りに来るだけの場合も、もう一度診察の受付をする必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受取のみの場合の受付要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My surname is written on it. If I am only coming to collect the jacket, do I still need to register for an appointment again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether registration is necessary when only collecting an item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察の受付ではなく、この総合受付でお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please speak to us at this general reception desk rather than registering for an appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。診察室へ直接戻らず、総合受付で忘れた上着を取りに来たと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察室へ戻らず総合受付へ行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will not go straight back to the examination room. I will tell general reception that I have come to collect the jacket I left behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will go to general reception without returning to the examination room. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 午後に受け取りにいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you come to collect it this afternoon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三時ごろ行けます。診察券も持参して、名前のテープを一緒に確認してから受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受取時間と診察券持参を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can come around three. I will bring my patient card too, check the name tape with you, and then collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your collection time and that you will bring your patient card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりしておきます。道中お気をつけてお越しください。それでは失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will keep it for you. Please take care on your way here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お電話をいただいた定期入れについてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about the commuter pass holder you called us about, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私の物だと確認できたそうですが、今日は仕事で来られません。兄に受け取りを頼めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事のため兄に受取を頼めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I understand you have confirmed it is mine, but I cannot come today because of work. May I ask my older brother to collect it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your older brother can collect it because you have work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人以外が受け取る場合の手続きを、担当者に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the person in charge about the procedure for collection by someone other than the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 兄にはまだ出発しないよう伝えます。必要な書類がそろってから来てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 必要書類が分かるまで兄を待機させると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will tell my brother not to leave yet. I would like him to come after all the necessary documents are ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will have your older brother wait until you know which documents are needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に確認したところ、委任状と、受け取る方の本人確認書類をご用意いただく案内でした。作成方法もこちらで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I checked with the person in charge, who advises bringing a letter of authorization and identification for the person collecting it. Let us also check how to prepare the letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 委任状には私の署名が必要ですね。拾われた定期入れの受付番号も、兄に渡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 署名と受付番号の共有を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The letter of authorization needs my signature, correct? I will also give my brother the reference number for the recovered pass holder.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the signature and sharing of the reference number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。ご本人との関係だけでなく、委任の内容が分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please make the scope of the authorization clear, as well as the person's relationship to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 定期入れの受け取りだけを頼んだと書きます。ほかの手続きまでお願いするつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 委任範囲を定期入れ受取に限定すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write that I am only asking him to collect the pass holder. I do not intend to authorize him to handle any other procedures.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the authorization is limited to collecting the pass holder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取日時も担当者と調整してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also arrange the collection date and time with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 兄が来られる夕方の時間を伝えます。書類の準備が間に合わなければ、私が別の日に受け取りに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 兄の受取時間と間に合わない場合の代案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them the evening time when my brother can come. If the documents cannot be ready in time, I will come to collect it myself another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your older brother's collection time and the alternative if preparations cannot be completed in time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当者からの案内をお待ちください。お仕事、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait for instructions from the person in charge. Take care at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お手紙の封をする前に、確認されたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check before sealing your letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 国内に住む母への手紙に、日本の小銭を入れました。普通の封筒で出そうとしていましたが、このままでよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 普通封筒への小銭同封を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I put some Japanese coins in a letter to my mother, who lives elsewhere in Japan. I was going to send it in an ordinary envelope, but I would like to ask whether that is all right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about enclosing coins in an ordinary envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現金を送る場合は、現金書留として扱います。普通の手紙には入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Cash must be sent by registered cash mail. Please do not put it in an ordinary letter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は手紙だけ送りたいので、小銭は全部取り出します。母には、送金は別にすると書き添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金を抜き送金は別と母に知らせると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only want to send the letter today, so I will take out all the coins. I will add a note to my mother saying I will send the money separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will remove the cash and tell your mother the money will be sent separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 便箋の間にも残っていないか、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check that there are none left between the sheets of writing paper either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二枚の便箋を広げて確認しました。記念写真だけは、この封筒に一緒に入れてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 便箋内の確認と写真同封を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I opened up both sheets of writing paper and checked. May I still include just the commemorative photograph in this envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you checked between the writing paper and ask about enclosing the photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真は折れにくいようにして入れられます。厚さや重さで料金が変わるので、完成後に量ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can include the photograph with protection against bending. The postage depends on thickness and weight, so we will weigh it when it is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 薄い厚紙で写真を挟みます。小銭を出した分だけ料金が安くなると決めず、重さを量ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真保護後の計量を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put the photograph between pieces of thin card. Please weigh it rather than assuming that removing the coins will lower the postage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to weigh the letter after you protect the photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封筒の宛先と差出人も、お書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also write the recipient's and sender's details on the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母の住所と自分の住所を書きました。中には手紙と写真だけがあるのを確かめて、封をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先差出人と手紙写真のみを確認して封じると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written my mother's address and my own address. I will check that only the letter and photograph are inside, then seal it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the recipient and sender details and that only the letter and photograph are inside before sealing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは封ができましたらお預かりします。お母様へお気持ちが届きますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will take it once you have sealed it. I hope your feelings reach your mother. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 硬貨のご入金について、お尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about depositing coins?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の貯金箱がいっぱいになりました。持って来る前に枚数を数えたいですが、どう分けるとよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貯金箱硬貨の持込前の数え方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My money box at home is full. I would like to count the coins before bringing them in. How should I sort them?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to count the coins from your money box before bringing them in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず種類ごとに分けてください。手数料の案内は、持ち込む枚数や手続きに応じて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, separate them by denomination. We will check the fees according to the number of coins you bring and the procedure involved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十円玉と百円玉が多いです。種類ごとに袋を分けて、袋の外に枚数を書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 種類別の袋に枚数を記すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are many ten-yen and hundred-yen coins. I will put each denomination in a separate bag and write the number of coins on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will mark the number of coins on separate bags for each denomination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: テープで貼り合わせたり、接着したりせずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please bring them without taping or gluing them together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十枚ずつテープで巻こうとしていました。巻かずに数えて、金額も自分のメモに残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: テープで巻かず金額も控えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was going to wrap them in tape in groups of ten. I will count them without wrapping them and also note the monetary amount for myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not wrap them in tape and will also record the amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外国の硬貨などが混じっていないかも、ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check for any foreign coins or other items mixed in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 旅行先の硬貨が一枚あります。それは別に保管して、日本の硬貨だけ持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外国硬貨を除くと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is one coin from a trip. I will keep it separately and bring only Japanese coins.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will remove the foreign coin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 枚数が分かったら、窓口で取り扱いと費用を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you know the number, please check the handling procedure and costs at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 合計が分かったら電話で相談します。手数料を聞いてから、全部入金するか一部だけにするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 枚数と費用確認後に入金量を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will call to discuss it once I know the total. After hearing the fees, I will decide whether to deposit all of them or only some.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will decide how many to deposit after checking the count and costs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご準備の際は硬貨をなくさないようご注意ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take care not to lose any coins while preparing them. Thank you for asking us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 卵のパックをご覧になって、何か気付きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you notice something while looking at that carton of eggs?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手前のパックの卵に細いひびがあります。まだ買っていませんが、次の人が選ぶ前に知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入前の卵のひびを店員へ知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a fine crack in an egg in the carton at the front. I have not bought it yet, but I wanted to tell you before the next person chooses it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell a store employee about a cracked egg before purchasing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのパックはこちらで確認します。ふたは開けられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check that carton. Have you opened the lid?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開けていません。透明なふた越しに見えました。自分で卵を入れ替えることもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封で卵交換もしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I have not. I saw it through the transparent lid. I have not swapped any eggs myself either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the carton is unopened and that you have not swapped any eggs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。確認のため、このパックを売り場から外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for telling us. We will remove this carton from the display to check it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は別のパックを一つ買います。奥にある物を取ってよいですか。それとも確認が終わるまで待ちますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別パックを選べるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will buy one different carton. May I take one from the back, or should I wait until you finish checking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can choose another carton. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別のパックをお選びいただけます。選んだ物にも気になる所があればお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may choose another carton. Please let us know if you notice anything concerning about the one you choose as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは外から見る限り、ひびが見えません。棚から取るとき、隣のパックにぶつけないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 選んだパック状態と隣への接触に注意すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: As far as I can see from outside, this one has no cracks. I will be careful not to knock the neighboring carton when taking it off the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the condition of your chosen carton and say you will avoid hitting the neighboring one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持ち帰り用の袋はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have a bag to carry them home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 底の平らな袋があります。ほかの買物を先に入れ、卵の上には缶を乗せずに運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 平底袋を使い卵上へ缶を置かないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a bag with a flat bottom. I will put my other shopping in first and carry the eggs without putting cans on top of them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use a flat-bottomed bag and will not put cans on the eggs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認にご協力いただきありがとうございました。お選びの卵を大切にお持ち帰りください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for helping us check. Please take care carrying your chosen eggs home. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その敷物、植え込みの方へ飛んでいった物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is that the mat that blew toward the planting bed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、私のです。荷物を持ち上げたら風に飛ばされました。枝に引っかかっていて、手が届きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 飛んだ敷物が枝に掛かり届かないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, it is mine. The wind blew it away when I lifted my belongings. It is caught on a branch, and I cannot reach it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your blown-away mat is caught on a branch out of reach. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 植え込みの中へ入らず、どの辺りか指していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you point out where it is without going into the planting bed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あの低い枝の向こうです。引っ張ると枝が折れそうなので、取るのをやめて係の方を探しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 場所を指し枝を傷めるため回収をやめたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is beyond that low branch. Pulling it might break the branch, so I stopped trying to retrieve it and looked for a staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the location and say you stopped retrieving it to avoid damaging the branch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで道具を使って外します。少し離れてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will use a tool to remove it. Please wait a little distance away.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもにも近づかないよう伝えます。敷物が取れるまで、ベンチで荷物をまとめています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもを離してベンチで待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will tell the children to keep away too. I will gather our belongings on the bench until the mat is retrieved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the children away and wait at the bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取れました。端に小さな穴がありますが、こちらの敷物で間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here it is. There is a small hole at the edge. Is this definitely your mat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、この青い縫い目が目印です。穴が広がらないように、今日は畳んで持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 縫い目で自分の敷物と確認し畳んで持ち帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, these blue stitches identify it. I will fold it up and take it home today so the hole does not get bigger.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify your mat by the stitching and say you will fold it up and take it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 風が強くなっていますので、軽い物は袋に入れておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The wind is getting stronger, so it would be a good idea to put light items in a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙皿も飛びそうなので袋に入れます。昼食は終わったので、落とした物がないか見て帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙皿を袋に収め落とし物確認後に帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The paper plates look likely to blow away too, so I will put them in a bag. We have finished lunch, so we will check for anything we have dropped before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will bag the paper plates and check for dropped belongings before going home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、足元の物も確かめてからお帰りください。またのお越しをお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21218-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please check the things around your feet as well before leaving. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符はお二人分でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are the tickets for two people?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、私は途中の駅で降りて、友人はその先まで行きます。別々に買えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人が別の駅で降りるため別々の切符を買いたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. However, I am getting off at an intermediate station, and my friend is going farther. Can we buy separate tickets?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to buy separate tickets because the two of you are getting off at different stations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの行き先を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me each of your destinations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私はこちらの路線図の三つ目、友人は五つ目の駅です。駅名を読み上げて確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 路線図を使い双方の行先を伝え駅名の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Mine is the third station on this route map, and my friend's is the fifth. I would like to read the station names aloud to check them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the route map to state both destinations and ask to confirm the station names. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。途中までは同じ列車で行ける組み合わせをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. I will explain a combination that lets you take the same train for the first part of the journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 助かります。乗り換える駅で別れると思っていたので、同じ列車のままでよければ安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ列車で途中まで同行できる案内に応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: That helps. I thought we would part at a transfer station, so I am relieved if we can stay on the same train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Respond to the explanation that you can travel together on the same train partway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先に降りる方の切符をこちらに、もう一枚をこちらに置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will put the ticket for the person getting off first here, and the other one here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 短い区間の切符が私の分ですね。友人には長い区間の方を渡して、混ざらないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短区間と長区間の切符を持つ人を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The ticket for the shorter journey is mine, correct? I will give my friend the one for the longer journey so they do not get mixed up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify who will hold the shorter-journey and longer-journey tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お支払いはご一緒でよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、二枚分をまとめて払います。友人との精算は後でします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚分をまとめて支払い友人とは後で精算すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I will pay for both tickets together. I will settle up with my friend afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pay for both tickets together and settle up with your friend later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、それぞれの切符をお持ちください。お二人とも、よい旅を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please each take your own ticket. Have a good journey, both of you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お名前の読み方を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me how to pronounce your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: こちらの欄の名前です。日本語では「グエン」と読みますが、途中で区切らずに読んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 窓口で使う姓名の読み方と区切り方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is the name in this field. In Japanese it is pronounced Nguyen, but please read it without breaking it up in the middle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain how to pronounce and group your family and given names for use at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。窓口でお呼びする時も、その読み方でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you. May we use that pronunciation when calling you at the counter too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。以前、姓の一部を名前だと思って呼ばれて、気づくのが遅れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 以前の呼び方では気づかなかった理由を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Previously, someone called me thinking part of my surname was my given name, so it took me a while to notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why you did not notice promptly when called that way before. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、読み方の欄も一緒に確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us also check the pronunciation field together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。この片仮名の最後が「ソ」になっています。私が書いたつもりなのは「ン」です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 片仮名のソをンに直したいと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. The last katakana character here is so. What I intended to write was n.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out that you want to change the katakana so to n. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この欄は訂正できるよう、担当者から書き方をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain how to write the correction in this field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。別の書類には正しく書いたので、この用紙の読み方だけ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回の用紙の読み方のみ訂正したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I wrote it correctly on the other documents, so I only want to correct the pronunciation on this form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you only want to correct the pronunciation on this particular form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用件は住所に関するお手続きで間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You are here for an address-related procedure, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。住所の相談で来ました。読み方を直したら、その窓口へ案内してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所相談を希望し訂正後の窓口案内を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I came to ask about my address. Once the pronunciation is corrected, please direct me to that counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want an address consultation and ask for directions to the counter after the correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。本日はお越しいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will put you in touch with the person in charge. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 外来のご用はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished your outpatient visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。付き添いで使った車椅子を返したいです。入口に戻すのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貸出車椅子の返却先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to return the wheelchair we used while accompanying my mother. Should I take it back to the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to return the borrowed wheelchair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 貸出しを受けた場所は、こちらの受付でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you borrow it from this reception desk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。受付の方が母に貸してくださいました。母は今、家族と車の乗り場で待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付で母に借りた経緯と母の待機場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The receptionist lent it to my mother. My mother is now waiting with family at the vehicle pickup area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that reception lent it to your mother and where your mother is waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お母様はもう車椅子をお使いにならないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: So your mother is no longer using the wheelchair?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。車への移動は家族が付き添いました。私だけ車椅子を押して戻って来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母は家族の介助で車へ移動済みと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is right. A family member accompanied her to the car. I came back on my own, pushing the wheelchair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother has already moved to the car with family assistance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返却はこちらでお受けします。座面にお荷物が残っていないかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We accept returns here. Please check that you have not left any belongings on the seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あ、背もたれの後ろに母の上着があります。返す前に取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 背もたれの後ろに残った母の上着を取ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Oh, my mother's jacket is behind the backrest. I will take it off before returning the wheelchair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will remove your mother's jacket left behind the backrest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お忘れ物が取れましたら、職員へお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have removed your forgotten belongings, please hand it to a staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 上着を取りました。貸していただいて助かりました。車椅子はここでお渡しして、母の所へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 上着を回収し車椅子を職員へ渡して母へ戻ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have taken the jacket. Thank you, borrowing it was a great help. I will hand the wheelchair over here and go back to my mother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have collected the jacket and will hand the wheelchair to staff before returning to your mother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお受けしました。お母様にもよろしくお伝えください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received it. Please give your mother our regards. Take care on your way home.
